svg.title: Moon Base layout
svg.text: MOON BASE · Moon Base · 70x46 tiles · road 3.25 tiles wide
Lap 207 tiles = 26,510 px · about 31 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.2 tiles · bridge crossing at 61°
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
